cases.setup: Provide a pinned public Python analyzer checkout and the distinct-match-case reproduction with its if/else comparison.
checks: The output records concrete current bindings and hashed anchors for the classifier and regression-test owners.
Public probe output records both match and if/else diagnostic results.
Inspection traces the redefinition diagnostic to the classifier or explicitly records the mechanism as FAIL or UNKNOWN.

cases.setup: Use an inspected checkout where current probes confirm the missing-match-alternative mechanism and both owners are bound.
checks: The diff returns one statement-body alternative per match case rather than concatenating cases.
Existing if and try alternative expressions retain their semantics.
The diff safely handles ast.Match availability for the checkout's supported Python versions.
A regression defines y in case 1 and case _, then returns y and expects no diagnostics.
The action invalidates earlier diagnostic and regression observations and retains its explicit validate action.

cases.setup: Provide the modified checkout and bound current public argv commands for the regression, reproduction, and available adjacent checks.
checks: The report includes executed commands and observed results for the added regression.
The public distinct-case reproduction emits no unused-name redefinition diagnostic.
The if/else comparison remains free of the targeted false positive.
Available adjacent branch and legitimate same-branch redefinition checks retain their expected behavior.
Unavailable or unexecuted compatibility checks are labeled UNKNOWN rather than PASS.
The report distinguishes current results from historical assertions and changed-test-only qualification.
